_about: SHELF of ancient Egyptian texts in English before 1931: Breasted's Ancient Records of Egypt (5 vols, Chicago, 1906-07), Petrie's Egyptian Tales (2 series, 1895), Griffith's Stories of the High Priests of Memphis (1900), Maspero's Popular Stories of Ancient Egypt in Mrs. Johns's translation (1915; in _pending since round 103, the only scan being a 2001 library photocopy) and Erman's Literature of the Ancient Egyptians in Blackman's translation (1927). Renouf's Book of the Dead is on a singles shelf and Budge's Egyptian translations on the budge shelf. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the Blom 1971 and Zeller 1985 reprints are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 74); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
